profile: Cadre manufactures and distributes safety equipment for law enforcement, first responders, military, and nuclear markets. Its products include body armor, explosive ordnance disposal equipment, duty gear, remote handling solutions, radioactive-material storage containers, and ventilation and containment systems. Through owned distribution, it also supplies third-party uniforms, optics, boots, firearms, and ammunition. Customers include government agencies, emergency services, and commercial nuclear operators.
